steps.name: limma DE on log TPM (lesional vs control)
steps.context: Same TPM table and metadata as T1S1. 12,000 genes; expect a large fraction to fall below the 1-TPM floor. Reference level set explicitly to control so positive log2FC means higher in lesional. limma is the only valid model class here: DESeq2/edgeR/voom are forbidden on TPM input (R-0004@a06d).
steps.question: Which genes differ between psoriasis lesional skin (6 samples) and control skin (6 samples), by limma on log2(TPM+1) with BH-adjusted p < 0.05?

grounding.reason: TPM input forbids count models (R-0004@a06d): limma on log2 TPM with trend+robust per the sourced procedure

constraints: filter_low_counts: keep genes with TPM >= 1 in at least 6 samples (smallest group size); report the number kept
normalize = log2_plus_1_only: no TMM/size-factor normalization on TPM
reference_level = explicit: set condition factor reference to control before fitting
contrast_form = factor_numerator_denominator: named contrast lesional-vs-control
differential_expression: eBayes(trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE) on log2(TPM+1)
multiple_testing = BH via topTable(adjust.method='BH'); select by adjusted p-value (alpha 0.05), not raw p or fold change alone
lfc_threshold_policy = test_against_threshold: additionally report treat() results against |log2FC| >= 1 as the effect-size-controlled list
Report n_tested after the filter beside n_significant
tpm.csv and metadata.csv row order must be joined on sample names, not assumed aligned
acceptance_criteria: Full results table (gene symbol, log2FC, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val) written as CSV
Counts of genes kept by the TPM filter, genes tested, and genes with BH adj.P.Val < 0.05 (and passing |log2FC| >= 1 under treat)
Top up- and down-regulated genes in lesional skin reported
Session info captured for the report step

steps.name: Reproducibility report of DE findings
steps.context: Depends on T1S2 results. The report must make explicit that only a TPM table was delivered: fold changes are abundance ratios from salmon TPM, no raw counts or quantification directories exist, results cannot be re-derived with count models, and recovering the raw counts or transcript quantifications would allow a more powerful reanalysis. TPM from different library protocols would not be comparable across samples, though this cohort is a single batch.
steps.question: What is the final answer to 'which genes differ between lesional and control samples', with full method, threshold, and provenance detail?

grounding.reason: Reporting per R-0041@059a and R-0086@becf: method, versions, design, thresholds, counts, session record

constraints: report_fields = method, package versions, design formula, contrast, thresholds (alpha, LFC), n_tested, n_DE, session_info
reproducibility_record = sessionInfo and package versions stored with the results
State the TPM-only caveat and the recommendation to request raw counts or quantification directories
List the top differentially expressed genes with direction and effect size
acceptance_criteria: A written report naming method, versions, design, contrast, thresholds, n_tested, n_DE, and the session info
Explicit TPM-only data caveat and reanalysis recommendation
Final ranked DE gene list attached to the report

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM
plan.analytical_narrative: The analysis receives only a gene-level TPM table (12,000 genes x 12 samples, salmon-derived, no raw counts or quantification dirs) plus a 12x2 metadata table describing 6 psoriasis lesional vs 6 control unpaired skin samples in a single batch. With TPM input and no counts, count-based models (DESeq2/edgeR/voom) are invalid; the grounded procedure is limma on log2(TPM+1) with trend=TRUE and robust empirical Bayes. Flow: (1) sample-structure QC on log values — PCA/MDS, sample distances, detected genes per sample — to confirm the 6v6 structure separates by condition and flag outliers; (2) single analysis step applying the 1-TPM floor (>= 6 samples, the smallest group size), log2(+1) transform, explicit control reference level, named contrast lesional-vs-control, limma eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE), and BH adjustment with results selected by adjusted p-value, with an optional treat-style test against |log2FC| >= 1; (3) a reproducibility report stating method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_DE genes, and the TPM-only caveat that fold changes are abundance ratios, not counts-based effects, and recommending recovery of raw counts or quantification directories for a definitive analysis.
